scope: Read-only maturity/gap assessment. No rerun of prior physical verification, no commercial commitment. Gates are project recommendations unless a cited provider explicitly requires them.

gates.current_stage: Research receiver screen, not product specification
observed_facts: Prior completed A/B/VCSEL candidates have separate nominal discrete simulated envelopes.
MicroLED and VCSEL use different emitter/RX proxies; they are not a common measured optical link.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Freeze net throughput, line coding/framing, optical launch/received power, distance/coupling, allowed current/voltage/temperature, BER target and energy boundary.
Record latency, startup/fault behavior and external ASIC/FPGA interface requirements.
open_environment_can_do: Write executable stimulus/receiver/energy contracts and consistency checks.
Keep training independent and reserve holdout frames before optimization.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Actual emitter and receiver specifications; optical path loss and performance conditions; intended application requirements.
exit_criteria: Versioned numerical specification with unambiguous net-bit denominator, receiver criteria and operating range.
Every requirement mapped to a simulation or hardware acceptance test.

gates.current_stage: Synthetic/traceable-example models; not actual load qualification
observed_facts: Fixed MicroLED optical/RX parameters are used for controlled comparison; a 20 um example is not an established size-dependent physical limit.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Emitter IV, LIV, CV, S21 or pulse/impulse response versus bias and temperature.
Parameter provenance, de-embedding reference plane, fit uncertainty and holdout validation.
VCSEL threshold, thermal roll-over, relaxation dynamics and operating-current limits; MicroLED differential lifetime/efficiency versus current density.
open_environment_can_do: Fit public or supplied measurements; run model sensitivity/identifiability and compare multiple plausible dynamic models.
Keep unmeasured parameters explicit and avoid treating eye-open proxies as measured BER.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Manufacturer or laboratory data for the selected emitter, package and bias/temperature range.
Optical/electrical measurements to close uncertainty when public data cannot identify the model.
exit_criteria: Model predicts independent measurements within predeclared tolerances over the intended operating range.
Remaining unmeasured parameters bounded and their effect on design decisions reported.

gates.current_stage: Circuit-level input stimuli; no complete system interface qualification
observed_facts: Latest candidates change input resistance, predrivers or steering-device dimensions.
An ideal stimulus source is not an implemented serializer/clock/input-pad interface.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Specify differential/single-ended levels, common mode, source impedance, jitter, termination and source-to-pad interconnect.
Design input pads/ESD, level conversion, buffering, clock/data paths and test mode.
open_environment_can_do: Model realistic source impedance/jitter and transistor input buffers.
Simulate input timing and power across PVT and package/board models.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Source ASIC/FPGA I/O characteristics, pad library and intended package/PCB S parameters or measurements.
exit_criteria: Driver meets rate/receiver/stress criteria under worst specified source amplitude/common mode/jitter and interconnect.
Energy includes the declared input/clock boundary; omitted serializer/CDR costs are explicit.

gates.topic: Reference, supply, startup and independent protection
gates.current_stage: Transistor reference/rail circuits exist; complete product safety/startup coverage not closed
observed_facts: Display macro uses external setup/passive elements and lacks complete internal POR.
High-speed normal communication is not evidence of power sequencing or fault-disable behavior.
B feed-forward capacitor can transfer transient charge even if DC bias is disabled.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Implement defined enable/disable, POR/brownout, reference-valid sequencing, open/short protection and recovery.
Check data toggling during disable, multiple power-up/down orders, hot-plug and supply disturbance.
Choose implementable reference/passive components and tolerances.
open_environment_can_do: Transistor transient/AC loops, operating-point sweeps, capacitor tolerance and fault-injection regression.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Real component tolerances, pad clamp behavior, supply ramp/board impedance; safety requirements and laboratory fault tests.
exit_criteria: Across declared corners, no overstress or unwanted optical/current pulse; bounded startup and recovery time.
No reliance on unimplemented ideal gates for independent shutdown.
External components and unintegrated reference sources clearly specified.

gates.topic: Steady energy, PVT, mismatch and receiver robustness
gates.current_stage: Nominal finite-frame research screens plus limited prior controls
observed_facts: Zero errors in a deterministic finite frame is not a demonstrated production BER.
Finite-frame positive-source energy may be influenced by initial capacitor storage and supply settling.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Use adequate warm-up and multiple steady windows; account for all declared supply/reference/clock sources.
Separate gross delivered energy, returned energy, stored-energy change and source-boundary omissions.
Expand PVT/independent resistor and capacitor variation/mismatch/package/supply/load sweeps.
Predeclare long code patterns, receiver noise/jitter model and acceptance criteria.
open_environment_can_do: Automated transistor sweeps, sensitivity, holdouts, sampling-step checks and energy convergence.
Statistical Monte Carlo only when model distributions/correlations are defensible.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Model statistical distributions and actual measured receiver noise/jitter/optical link; long-run BER and thermal behavior.
exit_criteria: No hidden initial-energy subsidy; steady energy change below a predeclared tolerance.
Current targets, stress, optical/RX margins and error criteria pass the agreed joint corner matrix.
Reported confidence/coverage matches the amount and type of evidence; no inferred 10^-12 BER from a short frame.

gates.current_stage: Pinned public PDK used locally; no provider acceptance
observed_facts: Historical flow selects gf180mcuD / 5LM_1TM_11K.
Public Google PDK README remains experimental and its repository is archived; underlying commercial process status is a separate issue.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Select exact provider-accepted process, BEOL/MIM options, PDK/decks/libraries, top-cell/slot/pad constraints and permitted tool flow.
Record version hashes and rule exceptions with acceptance authority.
open_environment_can_do: Maintain locked reproducible environments and local rule checks.
Adapt a public platform template only within its stated constraints.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: MPW/foundry confirms eligibility, accepted PDK version, delivery format, signoff requirements and waivers.
exit_criteria: Written provider-specific acceptance checklist and matching PDK/library access.
No unreviewed mixing of models, physical layers and BEOL options.

gates.topic: New full driver layout and physical verification
gates.current_stage: Historical macros pass local checks; latest 20/21/73 MOS candidates lack matching layout
observed_facts: Historical high-speed A/B cores are 6/9 MOS and cannot certify latest full circuits.
Common display top has 7277 MOS with physical receipts but no full-top transistor transient closure.
DRM Appendix B lists a prohibition on sharing one DNWELL between 3.3 V and 6 V devices.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: New floorplan includes references, regulation, protection, mixed-voltage wells, taps/guard rings, real capacitors, test access and selected I/O.
DRC/LVS/ERC, antenna/density/fill, hand checks of non-coded rules and routing/return-path review.
Full extracted simulation of the actual revision, with the agreed RC corners and negative controls.
open_environment_can_do: Magic/KLayout/Netgen and extraction; OpenROAD for digital implementation/STA where applicable.
Hash-linked GDS/CDL/PEX and extraction topology audit.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Accepted foundry decks and manual requirements, pad/ESD library qualification, calibrated RC corners and signoff review.
exit_criteria: Same final circuit and GDS uniquely match under approved LVS scope.
No unresolved required violations; each waiver explicitly authorized.
Post-layout target/next-failure regressions and protection/energy checks pass under the declared extraction conditions.

gates.current_stage: Core terminal-stress checks; no complete chip qualification
observed_facts: Existing boundaries exclude complete pad ring, ESD, package and external signoff.
Normal MOS terminal-voltage screening does not establish HBM/CDM, latchup or electromigration qualification.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Integrate qualified/accepted I/O protection, full supply/return network, decoupling and physical isolation.
Check dynamic IR/ground bounce, terminal/body stress, current density/via redundancy, hot spots and reliability limits.
open_environment_can_do: Static IR/EM screening using suitable rules, SPICE supply-network transients and package proxy sweeps.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Pad/library ESD data, process reliability limits, calibrated thermal/package models; HBM/CDM/latchup and lifetime qualification.
exit_criteria: Specified voltage/temperature/current conditions meet relevant reliability rules and circuit targets.
ESD/thermal/qualification scope is explicitly accepted or measured rather than inferred from DRC.

gates.current_stage: Teaching 3D and lumped parasitic proxies; no accepted physical assembly
observed_facts: Blender models use exaggerated heights/separation and do not solve electrical or thermal fields.
Small core area does not include pad/ESD/seal-ring/package constraints.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Choose emitter mounting, wirebond/flip-chip, substrate/PCB return paths, optical aperture/coupling and thermal path before final die layout.
Provide die/pad coordinates, bond map, orientation, thickness, mechanical/optical tolerances and qualified stackups.
Extract/package S parameters or justified RLC with correct reference planes and de-embedding.
open_environment_can_do: 2D GDS/assembly drawings, Blender explanatory models, circuit co-simulation and sensitivity.
Field-solving only with appropriate geometry/material parameters and validation.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Assembly house feasibility review; package/process tolerances, optical alignment, thermal/mechanical reliability and measured interconnect.
exit_criteria: Assembler-approved drawing and connectivity; electrically/optically feasible geometry.
Post-package model and measurements retain target margin without excessive ringing, heating or coupling loss.

gates.topic: DFT, wafer test and first-silicon characterization
gates.current_stage: Research logs and software screens; no manufacturing test program
observed_facts: Open tools provide some scan operations but this design has no closed ATPG/ATE/analog test-coverage package.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Digital test access/scan or justified alternatives; analog monitors and isolated test modes.
Pin list, register map, vectors, safe power sequences, current limits, test limits/calibration and fault taxonomy.
Plan DC/IV/LIV, frequency/S21, eye/BER, temperature and fault tests with fixtures.
open_environment_can_do: Test RTL and vectors, scan planning, fault injection and simulation-to-measurement comparison scripts.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Wafer prober/ATE or agreed lab fixtures; real silicon/optical instruments; calibrated measurements and sample/yield data.
exit_criteria: Test modes verified in design and accessible after packaging.
Measured silicon/optical results meet predeclared acceptance criteria; discrepancy investigation complete.
Manufacturing coverage/yield test distinguished from one-off research characterization.

gates.current_stage: Reproducible research repository; not a released production product
observed_facts: No wafer booking, manufacturing acceptance, production quote or measured yield/qualification is asserted.
required_design_verification_and_deliver: Deliver final hierarchical GDSII/all required layers plus agreed netlists, rule reports, waiver log, package/pad and test files.
Version manifest, license/IP provenance, restoration instructions and immutable release.
Separate engineering sample acceptance from volume reliability/yield/cost/traceability release.
open_environment_can_do: Prepare reproducible handoff bundle, checksums, artifact comparison and review documentation.
requires_external_confirmation_or_hardwa: Foundry/MPW intake acceptance; assembly/test signoff; actual lot results, yield, qualification and commercial supply agreement.
exit_criteria: Each recipient accepts its own deliverables and requirements.
Fabrication result is tested; production qualification and unit economics rely on real process/test/assembly evidence.

can_continue_without_new_hardware_now: Reproduce and improve schematic drivers with locked fair-comparison conditions.
Implement and extract new layouts against the selected full open PDK while marking signoff limitations.
Prepare interface, package, test and manufacturing-delivery specifications.
external_engagement_needed_before_final_: Provider-accepted process/PDK, pad and ESD libraries, MPW slot and die constraints.
Feasible emitter assembly, pad/bond/return-path layout, thermal/optical interface and obtainable models.
hardware_needed_to_close: Emitter dynamic model accuracy when public data do not identify it.
Optical BER/OMA/LIV/bandwidth, supply/thermal interactions and package/board parasitics.
ESD/latchup/lifetime, wafer/package test yield and actual manufacturing cost.
decision_rule: Compare methods only at common declared targets and evidence boundaries; do not select a production architecture solely from lowest short-frame errors or prelayout pJ/net-bit.
